svg.aria-label: Punctuation alone names the author of 241 of 708 books (34%), across 132 authors with three or more works: the books drop as dots into a pink pile named right and a larger chalk pile named wrong. Underneath, on a percent scale: with author labels shuffled, the same test gets 0.8% (chance is 1 in 132); with labels shuffled only among books of the same genre, 4.2%. English originals alone get 35%.
svg.text: 708 books by 132 authors, one dot each
